reasoning_content: The tables do exist (block_content, flag_counts, etc.) — meaning the `install_profile_modules` task has actually been run, and modules have already been installed. cd /workspace
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush sqlq 'SHOW TABLES' 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev drush sqlq "SELECT * FROM system" 2>&1 | head -8
